first_run.error: ValueError: O3 cache reference audit failed: center=[{'maximum_absolute_logit_difference': 0.037109375, 'prediction_agreement': 0.9997983574867249}], m1=[{'maximum_absolute_logit_difference': 7.642681121826172, 'prediction_agreement': 0.9934139847755432}]

root_cause.summary: Batch-size mismatch inside the queue script. The two reference caches are generated by cache_validation_logits at --batch-size 128, while the two D1 caches are generated by cache_local_adapter_features at --batch-size 64. Convolution/attention numerics on this GPU depend on batch size, so the D1 global logits differ by up to 0.037 from the center reference; the tiny global difference changes the attention top-5 patch selection for a few samples, which then produces large local-logit divergences. The pre-registered audit is fail-closed and demands bit-exact center globals and a <=4e-6 M1 fusion recompute, so it rejected the cache.
not_causes: image preprocessing: both CLIs use the same build_model preprocess; select_inference_preprocess(mode=clip_center_crop) is the identity
AMP: both CLIs derive use_amp from the same config train.amp
data split: both use artifacts/stages/repechage/20260921/val_dev.csv in the same order

verification.method: Re-ran cache_local_adapter_features on the validation split at --batch-size 128 and compared tensors against both reference caches.

fix.change: D1 train cache and D1 validation cache now use --batch-size 128, matching the reference generators; the audit gate and its tolerances were not modified.
fix.expected_audit_result: center maximum_absolute_logit_difference == 0.0 with agreement 1.0; m1 maximum_absolute_logit_difference 3.8147e-06 <= 4.0e-06 with agreement 1.0

subsequent.second_failure: With the batch-size fix the reference audit passed, but the next gate failed: 'O3 zero-initialisation audit failed: {maximum_absolute_logit_difference: 0.010011672973632812, prediction_agreement: 0.9997983574867249}'. Cause: the O3 evaluation recomputed the shared linear head in fp32 from the cached features, while the cached logits were produced by an autocast forward, so a zero-initialised adapter could not be bit-exact.
subsequent.resolution: O3 evaluation now uses anchored_classifier_residual_logits, the same construction the part-token unit already used: cached local logits plus the fp32 classifier residual of (adapted - base). The residual is exactly zero at initialisation, so the gate holds by construction and gradients are unchanged. Audit gate and tolerances were not modified.
subsequent.unit_verdict: D1 then ran to completion and finished as FAIL with delta 0.0pp: every epoch was rejected by the safety gate because the fused prediction left 4-5 classes empty. See results/f05_focus_d1_o3_result_20260925.json.
